description: This file is a Python source code file responsible for the core inductor functionalities within the PyTorch project. It provides functions for compiling, packaging, and loading models with TorchInductor, including support for AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) compilation, standalone compilation, and various configuration options. It also manages internal dependencies, type annotations, and exposes API functions for external use.
